item.description: Cape Fear Community College is bringing "Free Concert Friday" to the Wilson Center.

item.title: DOT threatening to withhold millions from North Carolina
item.description: Thursday night The Department of Transportation is threatening to withhold millions in federal funding for the state of North Carolina.

item.title: Man charged with murder in road-rage shooting off Hwy 90
item.description: A suspect was arrested for shooting a man Tuesday after a crash on Highway 90, according to the Horry County Police Department.

item.title: Shane Handy retires as West Brunswick’s head football coach
item.description: In an offseason that already saw three head coaches for Carolina Coast football teams step down, add one more to the list.

item.title: Wilmington childcare center catches on fire
item.description: The College Road Early Childhood Center experienced a fire within the building Thursday night. The fire was quickly extinguished, and school staff and administration met first responders on the scene to assess the situation. There will be no school for students, tomorrow, Friday, January 9th.

item.title: Early momentum carries New Hanover to 56-41 win over Ashley
item.description: New Hanover girls basketball remained undefeated in conference play with a 56-41 home win over Ashley.

item.title: New Hanover cruises past Ashley 74-24
item.description: In their first meeting of the season, New Hanover took down rival Ashley 74-24 on Thursday.

item.title: Hoggard handles Laney 54-20
item.description: Hoggard girls basketball had no trouble taking down Laney 54-20 on Thursday.

item.title: Laney takes down Hoggard on the road 63-57
item.description: Laney boys basketball got one of their biggest wins so far with a 63-57 road win against rival Hoggard.

item.title: Two organizations get approval for their expansions in Brunswick County
item.description: Two organizations in Brunswick County get their special permit use approved to expand their property at the Brunswick Board of Adjustment Meeting.
